title: PTGui Patch Tool Tutorial: Patching nadir/zenith and object removal in PTGui Pro

locations.name: Geysir, Iceland
locations.basis: Explicit in transcript: "images were taken at the geyser in Iceland, at Geysir"

summary: This PTGui Patch Tool tutorial demonstrates how to fill gaps and remove unwanted objects in spherical panoramas using PTGui Pro. It covers two patching workflows: editing patch images externally with Photoshop or AI tools and using PTGui Pro's integrated Patch Editor. The example panorama is a fisheye shot from Iceland’s Geysir area, used to show handling nadir/zenith gaps, tone mapping, and seamless blending. The video explains patch image formats (TIFF, JPEG 2000, OpenEXR, JPEG), where patch images are saved, and how patches are incorporated into the project as dedicated sources with masks. It then walks through both workflows—external editor patching followed by automatic project reload, and a fully PTGui-centric Patch Editor approach—highlighting cut versus patch modes, hole creation, dragging patches, vertex edits, and seam visualization to achieve seamless blending.

sections.title: Patch Tool overview and integration options
sections.description: Introduces the Patch Tool in PTGui Pro and explains two workflows: patching via an external editor (Photoshop or AI tools) and using PTGui Pro’s built-in Patch Editor for direct patch work.

sections.title: Panorama preparation and nadir gap assessment
sections.description: Sets up the example panorama from Geysir, discusses camera setup, deliberate underexposure to preserve sky, and demonstrates viewing controls and initial gap assessment in the Detail Viewer.

sections.title: External patch editing workflow and file formats
sections.description: Shows selecting a patch file format, saving the patch image next to the PTGui project, choosing how to process the patch (open in integrated Patch Editor vs external editor vs Finder/Explorer), and beginning an external patching workflow with Photoshop."

sections.title: In-PTGui Patch Editor workflow: Cut mode and Patch mode
sections.description: Demonstrates using PTGui Pro’s Patch Editor to create and edit patch images without external tools. Covers creating holes (Cut mode), patching by dragging contents (Patch mode), moving/rotating/editing patches, adding vertices, seam visualization (red seam), and the built-in blending approach (zero overlap blender) with automatic project reload after edits.
